name: BOB
summary: BOB, also known as 4-bromo-2,5,β-trimethoxyphenethylamine or as β-methoxy-2C-B, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and BOx families. It is the β-methoxy derivative of 2C-B. BOB was first synthesized by Alexander Shulgin.

pharmacology.text: BOB acts as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist. Its affinity (Ki) was found to be 2.0 nM and its EC50 was 0.12 nM with an Emax 63%. Its affinity was 20-fold lower than that of DOB, its activational potency was half that of DOB and its efficacy was slightly higher than that of DOB (63% and 38%, respectively). 2C-B was said to have comparable affinity as DOB.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is a rare research chemical with no medical use, known mainly from Shulgin's writings and from laboratory studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它是罕見的研究化學品，沒有醫療用途，主要見於 Shulgin 的著作與血清素受體的實驗室研究。
uses.zhHans: 它是罕见的研究化学品，没有医疗用途，主要见于 Shulgin 的著作与血清素受体的实验室研究。

sideEffects.en: Very little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of the 2C family can cause nausea, anxiety, a raised heart rate and blood pressure, muscle tension and confusion, and can trigger psychosis in people who are prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知極少。2C 家族的迷幻藥可能造成噁心、焦慮、心跳與血壓上升、肌肉緊繃與混亂，並可能在易感者身上誘發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知极少。2C 家族的迷幻药可能造成恶心、焦虑、心跳与血压上升、肌肉紧绷与混乱，并可能在易感者身上诱发精神病。

fact.en: BOB is 2C-B with an extra methoxy group on the side chain, and it was first made by Alexander Shulgin. The BOx name comes from that beta position oxygen.
fact.zh: BOB 是在 2C-B 側鏈上多加一個甲氧基的產物，最早由 Alexander Shulgin 合成。BOx 這個名稱取自 β 位上的氧。
fact.zhHans: BOB 是在 2C-B 侧链上多加一个甲氧基的产物，最早由 Alexander Shulgin 合成。BOx 这个名称取自 β 位上的氧。
